record.one_liner: Waterfall aggregates 30+ B2B data vendors behind one API for contact, email, phone and company enrichment, prospecting, contact search and job-change tracking.
record.auth_notes: Static API key sent in the x-api-key header to https://api.waterfall.io. A master key can create sub-keys. No OAuth documented. The marketing homepage shows x-waterfall-api-key in some examples, but the docs say x-api-key.
record.access_notes: The docs do not describe self-serve key creation. The Authentication and Evaluate pages both say to contact support@waterfall.io for API access, a test plan and pricing. The homepage CTA is "Book a Call". Pricing is usage-based with no amounts published. No free tier, trial or sandbox is mentioned. It is not confirmed whether a signup flow exists outside the docs.
record.blocker: No self-serve credentials. A developer must contact Waterfall sales/support to get an API key. The API itself is documented and agent-friendly: 13 endpoints, 50 requests per 60 seconds by default, async jobs with webhooks.
